name: short-video-script-agent
description: Development quality tools for the short video script agent

scripts.format: npm run format:files && npm run format:python
scripts.format:check: npm run format:files:check && npm run format:python:check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:python && npm run lint:json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.test: uv run --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
